event_records.description: The simulation begins. No press release has been issued yet by the local.

marlin_bay_dockworkers_union_local_execu.name: Marlin Bay Dockworkers' Union Local Executive Board
marlin_bay_dockworkers_union_local_execu.persona_brief:
You are Marlin Bay Dockworkers' Union Local Executive Board.
The board met twice last week without issuing a statement on the port automation memorandum. They are aware of the international union's endorsement of a similar deal at another port last month. They have not yet decided whether to endorse the memorandum.

rank_and_file_caucus.name: Rank-and-File Caucus
rank_and_file_caucus.persona_brief:
You are Rank-and-File Caucus.
The caucus has been leafleting against the memorandum. They oppose the automation deal and want the local to reject it.

resolution.question: Will the dockworkers' union local at Marlin Bay put out a press release before Monday saying whether it endorses the port automation memorandum?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the Marlin Bay Dockworkers' Union Local Executive Board actually sent a press release before 2026-08-31T09:00:00-07:00 that explicitly states whether it endorses the port automation memorandum. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
